Treated wastewater flows to the final storage pond (Pond 5), from which it may either be recycled or dechlorinated with ascorbic acid and discharged to the Napa River.
Treatment is expected to include a headworks with coarse screening;
The ponds that currently provide biological treatment and polishing will be modified for use as flow equalization and storage basins.
